_comment: DIAB GS30 (GSC30) 'Grid Scored' core, modelled per Laustsen et al. (2014), J. Sandwich Struct. Mater. 16(5):481-510 (see notes/refs/laustsen2014_grid_scored_rve.md). Divinycell H60 foam grid-scored in both directions at 30 mm center-to-center, ~1 mm kerf, cut to ~2 mm from the bottom (single-sided, scrim on the uncut face). RVE = one 30x30 mm periodic cell on a 20 mm sheet (groove depth 18 mm). Core uses the paper's ORTHOTROPIC H60 foam (in-plane E=32 MPa, through-thickness E=70 MPa) -> requires backend 'numpy' (the ccx/mfem integrators are isotropic-only). Resin = epoxy 'Resin A' (E=3 GPa). b3_core's full-FE periodic result is in the same ballpark as the paper's rule-of-mixtures Table 2 (E~(132,132,262), G~(20,57,57) MPa), agreeing best on E33 and the shear moduli.
